variant: X1 Kit retrofit for existing pile drivers such as Vermeer PD10
name: Xpanner X1 Piling (X1 Kit)
specialisedFor: utility-scale solar construction: driving tracker foundation piles
summary: Retrofit automation kit (controller, sensor and AI module, dashboard) that turns an existing solar pile driver such as the Vermeer PD10 into a one-touch machine that drives, aligns, hammers and checks plumb by itself. Xpanner says it has been used at more than 60 US sites.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU sales route found. Xpanner (Santa Fe Springs, California) installs the kit, trains operators and gives field support itself; the deployments it lists are in Arizona, Texas, Colorado, Missouri and Australia.
